about: People: for each guest in a corpus of 355 AI podcast episodes, reviewers went through their episodes from newest to oldest and kept the first substantive long-form interview. For guests with fewer than 20 questions, older episodes were added until they passed 20 or ran out.
Transcripts: gpt-6-luna (medium) cleaned each transcript turn by turn, keeping the speakers' own words, removing filler and backchannels, merging continuations and repairing caption speaker labels.

Questions: for every guest answer of 30 or more words, gpt-6.1-sol (medium) wrote interview-style questions about how the guest understands an entity or event, keeping only those whose answer shows judgment or taste. Each answer is the guest's own reply in the first person, supported by verbatim quotes from the cleaned transcript.
Rubrics: gpt-6.1-sol (medium) turned each answer into one-idea criteria with the v10 rubric writer. Rubrics are what a model's answer is checked against.

Model results: so far only four guests (Karthik Narasimhan, Zhuang Liu, Ilya Sutskever, Ray Dalio) have been evaluated. Each model saw a one-line host introduction and the question, answered as the guest at xhigh effort without tools, and gpt-6-luna (high) judged it against the rubrics without seeing the guest's answer. Scores measure coverage of the guest's ideas, not overall answer quality.

Caveats: answers from non-English episodes come from English translations. ASR and speaker attribution can be wrong. Photos come from public web pages or frames of the episode video. Descriptions are short summaries and may be out of date.
